before.command: installed executor check mail_send in disposable writable operational home; worker opens the resulting ledger with truncate mode

storage_capability_probe.append_flag_refusal: chattr: Operation not permitted while setting flags on <synthetic-ledger>
storage_capability_probe.refusal_redaction: Only the disposable task file path is replaced by <synthetic-ledger>.

required_capability: Administrator provisions and runs a separate-UID writer/collector with the only writable access to storage and non-worker-replaceable parents; worker receives an append-only submission interface. Linux filesystem append flags additionally require CAP_LINUX_IMMUTABLE on a supporting filesystem. Giving that capability to the worker would let it clear its own flag and would not meet independent-writer isolation.
after: NOT RUN: no independent writer or protected storage provisioned
